title: IStatefulDevice per-tick chip capture
body: IStatefulDevice (StateName, StateSize, CaptureState(Span), DecodeState) is implemented by VIC/SID/CIA/PLA. The recorder preallocates per-slot buffers (zero-alloc capture) and deep-copies on Snapshot; the pump registers Machine.Devices.All.OfType<IStatefulDevice>() before subscribing and the host decodes in the same order.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A captured tick carries each device's StateSize bytes; capture allocates nothing on the hot path
Snapshot deep-copies chip state so ring reuse cannot corrupt an earlier snapshot
